confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Argentine prices are volatile and quoted in pesos, so USD levels may have shifted substantially by July 2026. July is low season for glacier tourism, which may put some accommodation below peak rates, but winter demand is uneven. The hotel and hostel anchors are the least certain. FX figure taken from the RBA latest-rates pages surfaced by web search (not the F11 historical file, which I could not open directly).
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Patagonian tourism towns in Argentina, such as Ushuaia, Bariloche, and El Chaltén, adjusted for El Calafate's remote location and tourist-driven pricing.
